body:
TNTWave

Realistic TNT chain reactions with zero server lag

What it does:

TNTWave replaces Minecraft's instant explosion system with a realistic wave propagation system. Instead of all blocks breaking in one tick and crashing your server, explosions now spread outward in rings with proper chain reactions, particles and sounds.

Features:

Zero server lag from mass TNT
Realistic shockwave effect
Chain reaction TNT ignition
Explosion particles and sounds on each wave
Works with any amount of TNT

Perfect for:

Anarchy servers
Faction servers
TNT cannon servers
Any server where TNT lag is a problem
Compatibility:

Purpur 1.21+
Paper 1.21+
Spigot 1.21+
